payload.message: I’ll run this as a constrained tool experiment: one parent web search, two fresh no-context subagents, then parent opens/clicks only after both child reports are back. No shell commands or file edits.

The parent search returned a Mozilla result directly under `www.mozilla.org` and a Python result under `test.python.org`; I’m keeping the result references literal rather than substituting URLs. Next I’m starting both child agents before the parent opens any child-returned refs.

Record whether that works and its new page reference. On a successfully opened page, choose the first numbered clickable link and report its source page reference, numeric link ID, and label. Send all exact observations to the parent. Make at most three web calls. Do not spawn further agents. Never invent references. If you cannot access web browsing, report that directly."}

payload.message: Both child reports are in. Each child’s control page reference is `turn1view0`, so I’ll now test those reported refs from the parent exactly as given, keeping the Python and Mozilla associations separate even though the ref strings collide.

**Experimental Report**

Parent web tool used: `web.run`.

Argument shapes used:
```json
{
  "search_query": [{"q": "..."}, {"q": "..."}],
  "response_length": "medium"
}
```
Follow-up parent shapes:
```json
{"open": [{"ref_id": "..."}], "response_length": "medium"}
{"click": [{"ref_id": "...", "id": 0}], "response_length": "medium"}
```

Parent search refs selected:
- Python: `turn0search7`, title `About the Python Web Site | Python.org`, URL `https://test.python.org/about/website/`
- Mozilla: `turn0search0`, title `Mozilla’s products — Mozilla (US) — Mozilla`, URL `https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/products/`

Subagents were spawned fresh with `fork_context:false`, the available no-history equivalent.

**Child Results**
Python child:
- First transferred-ref open: `turn0search7`
- Result: error, returned ref `turn0view0`
- Exact error: `Unable to resolve open call: open({"ref_id":"turn0search7","lineno":null}) due to invalid ref_id argument`
- Control open: `https://www.python.org/`
- Worked: yes, page ref `turn1view0`
- Title/URL: `Welcome to Python.org (https://www.python.org/)`
- First numbered link: source `turn1view0`, ID `0`, label `▼ Close`

Mozilla child:
- First transferred-ref open: `turn0search0`
- Result: error, returned ref `turn0view0`
- Exact error: `Unable to resolve open call: open({"ref_id":"turn0search0","lineno":null}) due to invalid ref_id argument`
- Control open: `https://www.mozilla.org/`
- Worked: yes, page ref `turn1view0`
- Title/URL: `Mozilla - Internet for people, not profit (US)`, redirected to `https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/`
- First numbered link: source `turn1view0`, ID `0`, label `Products`

**Parent Follow-Up**
Python association:
- Parent open on child source `turn1view0`: error, returned `turn0view0`
- Exact error: `Unable to resolve open call: open({"ref_id":"turn1view0","lineno":null}) due to invalid ref_id argument`
- Parent click `turn1view0`, ID `0`: error, returned `turn1view0`
- Exact error: `Unable to resolve click call: click({"ref_id":"turn1view0","id":0}) due to invalid arguments`

Mozilla association:
- Parent open on child source `turn1view0`: error, returned `turn0view1`
- Exact error: `Unable to resolve open call: open({"ref_id":"turn1view0","lineno":null}) due to invalid ref_id argument`
- Parent click `turn1view0`, ID `0`: error, returned `turn1view1`
- Exact error: `Unable to resolve click call: click({"ref_id":"turn1view0","id":0}) due to invalid arguments`

Observed ref collisions:
- Yes. Both children reported `turn0view0` for the failed transferred-ref open.
- Yes. Both children reported `turn1view0` as their successful control page source ref.

Protocol deviations:
- The parent search did not return `www.python.org` as the selected Python result; the selected Python search ref was `https://test.python.org/about/website/`, because I used only the single required parent search call and did not substitute a URL.
- No shell commands, file edits, people-contact, or extra child agents were used.
